summary: Build product operating models, prioritization systems, and leadership routines. Train your team to deliver clearer product outcomes.
lede: Product leadership and product organisation training helps professionals structure how teams set direction, prioritize work, and coordinate delivery. It is designed for product managers, product operations leaders, and executives responsible for product teams, and addresses the practical task of building a repeatable operating model across discovery, planning, and delivery. Participants work on decision rights and team rhythms, use discovery and prioritization methods such as Jobs-to-be-Done, RICE, and MoSCoW, and develop roadmaps, product metrics, and dashboards for review.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already work in or around product functions and need to strengthen leadership, structure, and execution across the product organisation.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of product management, product delivery, or cross-functional team coordination; familiarity with basic roadmap and KPI concepts; no programming required. Prior exposure to Scrum, Agile delivery, or product analytics is helpful but not mandatory. You should bring a product challenge, current roadmap, or organisational design question from your own work so you can apply the course tools to a real context. Advanced concepts are taught at operational application level, with hands-on practice in planning, prioritization, governance design, and reporting artefacts.
